[EN] Despite all the relics scattered around here, there hasn't been nearly enough research on the giants or Aurum Road.

If we could just recover a bit of their technology, we could learn so much! I don't understand this resistance.
[ES] A pesar de todas las reliquias esparcidas por aquí, no ha habido casi nada de investigación sobre los gigantes o Aurum Road.

¡Si tan solo pudiéramos recuperar un poco de su tecnología, podríamos aprender muchísimo! No entiendo esta resistencia.
